# Furniture models (drop-in)

Real 3D models for world-building furniture. Registered types render as models;
others stay procedural. Loaded via `ModelRegistry` with uniform 2.2× scale
(Kenney furniture units → metres) and ground-aligned.

Shipped: table, chair, bed, shelf (Kenney Furniture Kit, CC0). Add more by
dropping GLBs here and extending `manifest.json` (keyed by furniture type used in
`FurnitureGenerator`). crate/barrel stay procedural (different source scale).

Source: Kenney.nl Furniture Kit — CC0 (public domain). Vertex-coloured, no
external textures.
